scope: Initial shared native i386 compatibility layer, exercised independently and by LINK captured-only fixtures. No archive, PE loader or original execution fallback.
checks: i386 PE/COFF and Microsoft FILE layouts
CRLF text output and translated input
bounded raw text-read and first-LF positioning flag
zero-sized CRT output buffers and trailing-percent formatting
VC1 equal-key qsort ordering and ordinary numeric sorting
writable mapping persistence, handle/view lifetime, mapped-truncation failure
module/export registry including absent IsTNT and unknown DLL
fixed test clock and file-error translation
PE child rejection without interpreter or Wine fallback
limits: LINK native fixture checks are output comparisons. Historical first-entry tracing, Windows SEH, specialized console/process/GUI and external PE dependencies are outside this initial implementation.
timing_note: Build and execution combined in each independent check. Prior checks during development were not all timed; these measurements are not total implementation work.
